title: PAX Banner Warrior Poses
description: Four side-by-side photographs of a young Black woman in an elaborate, battle-worn orange and black armored costume with spiked shoulder pads, belts, and boots. She strikes four different dynamic fighting stances in front of large banners displaying the text 'PAX' and 'BEGINNER'.
prompt: A young Black woman with short curly hair wearing a detailed dystopian warrior costume in bright orange and black with spikes, belts, and heavy boots, performing four different dynamic combat poses side by side, standing in front of large gray banners that read PAX BEGINNER, studio lighting, realistic live action photograph, character reference sheet
